sources.publisher: Greater London Authority / London planning authorities
sources.source_type: official planning application and lifecycle API
sources.coverage_years: Queried actual_commencement_date and actual_completion_date for 2020-01-01 through 2026-05-19.
sources.update_frequency: Daily according to London Datastore/GLA PLD guidance.
sources.geographic_scope: Greater London planning authorities represented in Planning London Datahub.
sources.license_or_terms_note: London Datastore applications source terms are not clearly stated as a bulk open-data licence in this repo. Candidate events retain factual row metadata, row URLs, publisher attribution and access date only.
sources.required_caveats: PLD lifecycle fields are administrative feed fields. They do not prove opening, occupation, design quality, current use, delivery outcomes, or causal effects; borough completeness and field semantics vary.
sources.ingestion_recommendation: Use selected high-signal lifecycle rows as documented planning-process milestones only, with inline limitations and source-row URLs.
